title: STEERING MULTIMODAL LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS DECODING FOR CONTEXT-AWARE SAFETY

bias_targets.methodology: Replacing original images in multimodal safety benchmarks with blank placeholders to measure if the model's refusal decisions rely predominantly on textual priors and statistical co-occurrence patterns rather than grounded visual evidence.

Measuring the rejection rate of benign but visually ambiguous or conceptually sensitive queries (e.g., negated harms, exaggerated risks) using the MOSSBench benchmark to evaluate model oversensitivity.
